title: 2761. Prime Pairs With Target Sum

examples.explanation: In this example, there are two prime pairs that satisfy the criteria. These pairs are [3,7] and [5,5], and we return them in the sorted order as described in the problem statement.
We can show that there is no prime number pair that gives a sum of 2, so we return an empty array.
